name: @onegrid/chart
description: Range charts for oneGrid — select a rectangle of cells and get a live chart bound to that selection. Derives a typed dataset from a columnar table (category-axis inference, numeric series detection, null holes), then draws line / bar / stacked-bar / area / scatter / pie / donut straight to a Canvas2D context with nice-number axes, gridlines and a legend. No dependencies, no DOM required.
